title: echinopsis multiangularis
intro: Echinopsis multiangularis, commonly known as the "Pachanoi" or "Senecio," is a type of cactus plant that belongs to the Echinopsis genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Echinopsis multiangularis include its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and improve sleep quality due to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids and glycosides. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ergine, ergonovine, and other psychoactive compounds that may contribute to its potential therapeutic effects.
